name: pg_publication_replica_identity_check
goal:
MERGE does not apply the same replica-identity safety checks as UPDATE and DELETE when its target table is published.

Publish a table that has no replica identity, then run MERGE commands containing reachable MATCHED UPDATE and MATCHED DELETE actions. They must be rejected with the existing update/delete replica-identity errors and hints. A MERGE containing only INSERT and DO NOTHING must remain legal, and UPDATE/DELETE actions against a published table with a valid primary-key replica identity must succeed. Non-published MERGE behavior must not change.
